Looking out across the grey, empty horizon where no land had ever rested, Arthur tucked the note into his pocket and began the long climb back to the lamp.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市退去了白日的喧嚣，街道空旷而寂静。昏黄的路灯在微凉的薄雾中投下长长的影子，偶尔有洒水车伴着清脆的音乐缓缓驶过，沥青路面泛起湿润的光泽。街角的便利店亮着温暖的灯，环卫工人的橙色马甲成为破晓前最先醒来的色彩，整座城正在静默中积蓄迎向朝阳的力量。", "w03": "- Recursion is like facing two mirrors toward each other so you see an endless hallway of yourself.\n- In coding, it means a task solves a big puzzle by repeating the exact same smaller step over and over.\n- You always need a stopping rule, like eating cookies one by one until the jar is completely empty."}
